mentions.name: NextBunny
mentions.description: Visual development platform for product builders that covers the whole path from idea to design to production in one system, eliminating handoffs and tool switching while giving full control. Optimized for Next.js and React apps and positioned as a modern, affordable Figma/Framer alternative without hype or lock-in.
mentions.problem: Design-to-development handoffs and constant tool switching, plus existing tools that are hyped and lock users in.
mentions.audience: Product builders, especially those building Next.js and React apps
mentions.source_excerpt: NextBunny is a visual development platform for product builders.One system to go from idea → design → production. No Handoffs. No tool switching. Full control.Perfect for Next.js and React apps.
